items.item_text: Professional certification preferred.
Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in a related area.
Advanced degree from an accredited university in a related area. (Preferred)

Five years of directly related, progressively responsible experience, or nine years of equivalent experience/training. An advanced degree in a related area is preferred and may substitute for one year of experience.
Demonstrated experience with preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and related presentations, and detailed variance analysis.

Demonstrated experience with improving business processes and accounting policies, to ensure efficient and effective internal controls, data integrity and compliance with internal and external policies and requirements.
Demonstrated experience in a leadership role in a large diversified and complex finance focused environment.
Experience leading or managing staff.
Financial Operations Management

Provides leadership, direction, and expertise to subordinates to achieve goals in accordance with established policies as well as decentralized financial activities. Manages the results of the University's financial operations, including general accounting, gifts and endowments accounting, capital projects, fixed assets, accounts receivable, grants, contracts, payroll feeds, and recharge accounting tracked with the applicable Oracle modules (General Ledger and supporting sub-ledgers).
Financial Reporting and Compliance
Meets all government reporting requirements for relevant financial activities. Manages all financial

reporting and maintains the Common Chart of Accounts. Manages miscellaneous billing transactions through the accounts receivable module. Ensures the accuracy and control of holistic financial data, including but not limited to Oracle Cloud Fusion modules, Accounts Receivable, Record to Report (General Ledger), Fixed Assets, and integrations with all other Oracle modules. Creates and maintains financial reports and completes monthly and year-end close of the general ledger. Completes all financial statements and applicable reporting. Responsible for review and completion of the monthly and fiscal year close processing of the financial system. Research and interpret specific

entries. Review of the following completed by subordinate staff: all transfer of funds, transfer of expenditures and financial journals, ad hoc general ledger account reconciliations, balance sheet account reconciliations. Supports audit evidence collection and information gathering as needed, and assigns audit-related tasks to subordinate staff and applicable campus partners.
Operations Administration

Manages, maintains, develops, and sets strategic direction and determines the overall objectives and portfolio of work for the Department. Assumes full responsibility for staffing, budgets, costs, productivity, and personnel activities of the department. Makes recommendations and implements decisions on issues that have department- and/or campus-wide impacts. Ensures efficiencies through lean practices with continued review of key performance indicators established throughout financial lifecycles. Provides training and professional development, either formally or on-the-job, for staff to ensure subject matter knowledge in appropriate areas (e.g., general accounting, administration, fixed assets administration, gift accounting, capital accounting).

Directly supervises professional and support staff and is responsible for the full range of supervisory activities, including recruitment, hiring recommendations, onboarding, training, work assignment, performance evaluation, employee development, corrective action, and resolution of employee concerns. Exercises independent judgment in personnel-related matters and ensures compliance with University policies, procedures, and applicable labor agreements
Monthly & Annual Fiscal Close

Manage the coordination for the fiscal close process for the campus and campus foundation. Manage through subordinates to ensure all requirements/steps are completed accurately and in a timely manner monthly in coordination with the campus and annually with UCOP closing schedules. Act as the management liaison with UCOP for the system closing process/audits. Review Financial

Statements and diagnostic reports in the UC system-wide consolidated financial reporting system and record correcting entries. Review the audit requirements for the outside audit firm. Supervise the completion of the audit with the external audit firm and ensure the management response and sign- off are completed. Supervise and review completion of campus financial statements and related audit deliverables.
Campus Support and Administration
Assist campus departments with complex accounting issues to ensure that financial transactions are properly recorded. Provide expert accounting guidance.
Thorough understanding and familiarity with all of the following: GAAP, GASB, FASB, Accounting law, professional systems and practices, Plant funds and capital accounting practices
Background check required.
Thorough knowledge of the organization's operational, personnel, and financial transactions and systems.
Thorough knowledge of finance, accounting, business and systems operations and regulatory compliance requirements.
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively across the organization at all levels.
Excellent skills using common desktop / web applications.
Excellent service orientation skills; strong skills in management and leadership; excellent ability to use critical thinking, sound judgment, and decision-making skills to creatively solve problems.
Strong knowledge of industry best practices.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret and document financial results trends and variances timely.
